profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft in Redmond.

Focus: Microsoft Azure, Big Data, AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I own the VSSDK build tooling and dev experience.
I drove, largely implemented, and owned the effort to make Sql Server Management Studio (SSMS) 21 fully integrated with the Visual Studio ecosystem, build systems, pipelines, and deployment method.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cloud capacity planning and management. 
- Worked with massive datasets describing Azure Usage
- Worked to enhance usage datasets to enable more accurate predictions of future capacity needs
- Worked to create and manage a system to allow generic data movement and alerting for thousands of datasets related to Azure Usage. 
- Ensured Timeliness, Completeness, and Accuracy of Azure Usage datasets.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enabled shipment of items purchased for cryptocurrency 

Created the Anti Money Laundering system used to: detect fraud, impose limits, prevention and reporting of suspicious users and transactions. This resulted in massively reduced fraud allowing our buy/sell of cryptocurrencies to become a profit center. 

Twitter bot to enable interactions with certain aspects of the site via twitter instead of requiring login. 

Integration with hardware wallets to allow users to seamlessly use their own private keys without requiring us to know the keys. 

Real time backup solution for SQL databases to enable management to be comfortable deploying SQL stored procedures from source control.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: International Experiences. Expanding Amazon to 150 new countries by 2022!

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
Azure Marketplace
- Wrote a tool and ran the process to discover billing errors and fix them. Resulting in a 15% more accurate billing system for azure marketplace.
- Implemented features to help manage enterprise accounts allowing them to more easily payoff overage bills and receive credits from Microsoft representatives.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
Microsoft Health
- Worked on the cloud implementation of MS Health and Band features. 
- Implemented system to communicate between patients and doctors and share test results 
- Implemented a system for a doctor to easily gain access to a patients complete medical record

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
Microsoft Teams
- Created a generic polling framework to allow user generated extensions to work in Microsoft Teams. 
- Helped run the LiveSite and DRI process for Microsoft Teams.  Responsible for training, running post mortems, etc.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
MSN and Bing Apps
- Stood up a sharing service for 7 vertical teams from scratch and maintained it. 
- Designed, implemented, tested, and maintained the Paywall Service for MSN apps. 
- Designed, implemented, tested, and maintained a search service for 7 Bing vertical teams.  This included features such as spelling, word breaking, query writing/validation and “result stitching.” 
- Drove a worldwide migration effort to move from hardware we managed ourselves to shared hardware, resulting in significant cost reductions, and reduced latencies.  This was an 8 month project requiring me to manage teams from the US, India, China, Australia, and the UK. 
- Worked with my team to implement a new profile management system with real time and multi-device updates.  This integrated technologies such as Azure, SignalR, Orleans, ODATA, and DocDB. 
- Created a health monitoring system for the MSN servers which reports current health of each machine and allows removing a single machine or a single Data Center from rotation with a single click.

positions.title: Associate Consultant
positions.description: I was a .Net consultant.  I work with customers everyday to provide solutions using Microsoft technology to real business problems.

positions.title: Software Research and Development Intern
positions.description: Wrote coded UI tests for a complex UI on a team of 8.

positions.title: Researcher in Computer science
positions.description: Worked on a research project in computer vision, specifically Content Based Image Retrieval using genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, and other mechanisms of retrieval with Dr. Xiaojun Qi.

positions.title: Student Applications Programmer
positions.description: -I Identified possible security risks for the University of Portland Database system. I also worked with and maintained the student database including removing duplicate identifiers and merging split data.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: -Performed customer service for the Postini mail system.  I also maintained and streamlined the network.  In addition, I wrote a piece of code to extract the needed user information from a large client database and format it for a data migration to a new system.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description: -Performed network maintenance and image editing.
